webster.text: Injustice; unrighteousness; a deviation from rectitude; as the iniquity of war; the iniquity of the slave trade.

example.quote: their iniquity, when they have it equally in their power to suppress and conceal it.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 5, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
